strings.<b>Design checks</b>: the engineer's rep: Design checks: the engineer's report lists problems (red blocks launch). Keep launch TWR above ~1.3, the centre of pressure (cyan) below the centre of mass (yellow), a heat shield under crew pods that return from orbit, and a parachute. Orbit takes about 3,400 m/s; a trip to a Luma landing and back needs roughly 6,000–6,300 m/s plus margin (the Luma Pathfinder starter carries about 7,600 m/s in vacuum). Low thrust-to-weight upper stages are fine in space; a lander needs a local TWR above ~1.5 at Luma (switch the readout to Luma surface).

strings.• <b>{0}</b> deletes the part under the: • {0} deletes the part under the cursor or the held part (or drop it on the parts list); {1} puts picked-up parts back.
strings.• <b>{0}</b> toggles angle snap (15° pos: • {0} toggles angle snap (15° positions, 90° rotation steps). {1} {2} {3} {4} {5} {6} rotate the held part, {7} for 5° steps, {8} resets.
strings.• Click a part in the list to pick it up: • Click a part in the list to pick it up, then click to attach it. Stack parts snap to the free nodes shown as green spheres; radial parts (fins, legs, boosters on radial decouplers, RCS, batteries…) attach to the surface of the part under the cursor.
strings.• Click a placed part to pick it up toge: • Click a placed part to pick it up together with everything attached below/beside it. {0}+click copies it. Clicking the root part picks up the whole craft to move it up or down (between the floor and the building's height limit); right-click a part → Make root part to re-root the craft on it.
strings.• Click empty space to <b>set the held p: • Click empty space to set the held parts aside: they stay there greyed out, are not part of the craft (not launched, not in the readouts) and can be built on, picked up and attached again.
strings.• Right-click a part for its details and: • Right-click a part for its details and settings (thrust limiter), {0} / {1} undo / redo, {2} save.
